summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Advanced Reports features. All 14 backend API tests passed (1 skipped due to only 1 payroll period available). Frontend testing verified all 4 tabs: Payroll Comparison, Financial Report, Centers Performance, and Inventory Alerts. All tabs load correctly and display data from APIs.

advanced_reports_page.details: Page loads at /advanced-reports with title 'التقارير المتقدمة' and 4 tabs with proper data-testid attributes

payroll_comparison_tab.details: Tab shows period selectors and comparison button. API /api/reports/payroll/comparison works correctly with validation for missing/invalid periods

financial_report_tab.details: Tab shows year/month selectors. API /api/reports/financial/monthly returns revenue, cost of goods, operating expenses, and profitability data. Shows 1,010 OMR cost of goods for January 2026

centers_performance_tab.details: Tab shows totals and centers table. API /api/reports/centers/performance returns 120 liters total, 1,010 OMR, 3 receptions, 1 center. Supports date filtering

inventory_alerts_tab.details: Tab shows 3 alerts (2 critical, 1 warning). API /api/reports/inventory/alerts returns feed and milk inventory alerts with severity levels

inventory_threshold_api.details: POST /api/reports/inventory/set-threshold correctly sets thresholds and validates required parameters

send_alerts_api.details: POST /api/reports/inventory/send-alerts works with email parameter. SMTP configured in .env for actual email sending

notification_settings_api.details: GET/POST /api/notifications/settings work correctly for managing notification preferences

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: AdvancedReports.jsx has ESLint warning about missing dependency 'fetchPayrollPeriods' in useEffect - consider adding to dependency array or using useCallback
updated_files: /app/tests/test_advanced_reports.py - Created comprehensive tests for all Advanced Reports APIs

success_rate.backend: 100% (14/15 tests passed, 1 skipped - payroll comparison needs 2 periods)

seed_data_creation: Set inventory threshold for raw_milk to 150 via API test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Advanced Reports page fully tested: 1) Payroll Comparison tab with period selectors (needs 2+ payroll periods for comparison), 2) Financial Report tab with year/month selectors showing revenue, costs, expenses, profitability, 3) Centers Performance tab showing milk collection data by center with rankings, 4) Inventory Alerts tab showing low stock items with critical/warning severity and email alert functionality. All APIs working correctly. SMTP configured for email alerts. No mocked APIs.
